svg.title: Engineering approach, four decisions in motion
svg.desc: (a) A build log where an import gate, an egress gate, 882 Python tests and three JS suites pass, then a change adds 'import torch' and the build fails. (b) Two kinds of failure are routed to two different named types. (c) Four models take turns on one 32 GB GPU, each holding the single lease while resident. (d) A telemetry frame is lost while the render keeps going to completion.
